messages:
Priya Shah: Hi team — Priya here, starting today as Product Designer on the onboarding squad. Need the shortest path to: Figma access, the canonical onboarding component file, where roadmap + experiment results live, and where research synths are kept. Any starter checklist?
Maya (Design System): Welcome Priya! :tada: Which email did you sign up with? I'll invite you to the DS team and share the library. The tokenized components live in Figma under Redwood DS > Components > Onboarding. Accept the library to get tokens.
Priya Shah: priya.shah@redwood.com — thanks! Also, do we have a preferred token naming scheme so I can match engineering?
Maya (Design System): We follow the token names in the Tokens spec document (Notion: Design System > Tokens). Use semantic names (e.g., color.primary, spacing.8). For code-ready exports ping eng-infra for the token-sync pipeline.
Jon_IT: Okta should have provisioned you. If Figma invite doesn't land check https://okta.redwood.com/apps -> Request Access -> Figma. If that fails run: ``/request-app figma priya.shah@redwood.com`` in Slack and I'll force a resend.
Arun (DesignOps): Sent invites and added you to #design-review and the crit calendar. Quick skim list: 1) Onboarding Components library, 2) Signup + Activation sprint file, 3) Onboarding research index (Notion). I'll DM links.
Lena (Research): Research pipeline: raw sessions + clips in Dovetail (project: onboarding_tests), synths in Notion under Research > Syntheses > Onboarding. Please add a 2-sentence TL;DR + 3 recommended actions for any note you create.
Hector_PM: Roadmap & experiments live in Notion: Product > Roadmap > Onboarding initiative. Experiment metrics (A/B) are in Analytics > Experiments (Looker). If you want context, I can do a 20m overview Thurs 10am.
Priya Shah: 10am works — thanks. One more: where are past usability clips for signup? Dovetail search is noisy for me.
Lena (Research): Use project filter "onboarding_signup" or tag "signup-usability". We also pin 60-90s highlight clips to the Notion onboarding index for quick skim.
Maya (Design System): When you update a component, publish it in the DS library and open a spec in the Product Spec DB. Tag eng-review and DS for token bumps. Small visual fixes can be handled via a library patch; breaking changes need a rollout plan.
Jon_IT: If you need a company device for testing mobile flows, book the device lab: https://infra.redwood.com/device-lab (pool: onboarding). DM me the booking id if anything blocks.
onboard-bot: Automated: added Priya Shah to "Design" Figma org and granted Notion read access (pending acceptance).
Priya Shah: Got the Figma invite and accepted the DS library. I'll skim the roadmap and book the 10am sync. Appreciate all the pointers :heart:
